title: AbTesting
description: Blind A/B model comparison extension (spec §11.10, extension id 'ab-testing'). The document root is the payload an agent publishes at CapabilitiesRegistry.extensionData['ab-testing'].payload: the opaque variant labels an evaluator may select, and a salted commitment to the label-to-configuration mapping. The real model or configuration behind a label is never part of this document or any other AEP surface (AEP-REQ-159). $defs/VariantBinding is the per-session snapshot carried on EvaluationSession.variant, Trace.variant, EvaluationResult.variant and the session.started stream event.

variants.description: The blinded labels an evaluator may request at session start, e.g. ["A", "B"]. Labels carry no description: anything describing a variant would leak which configuration it is (AEP-REQ-155).

selection.description: 'required': every session against this agent MUST name a variant; a session start without one is refused with -32080. 'optional': a session without a variant runs the agent's ordinary configuration and is not part of the experiment.

VariantLabel.description: A blinded variant label: a single uppercase letter. The pattern is deliberately narrow so a label cannot spell, abbreviate or hint at a model, provider, size or version (AEP-REQ-155).

ExperimentId.description: Opaque identifier for the experiment. MUST NOT encode model names, providers, versions or any other hint at the configurations under comparison (AEP-REQ-155).

ExperimentVersion.description: Opaque version of the label-to-configuration mapping. Changes whenever any assignment changes (AEP-REQ-158). Evaluators compare variants only within one experimentVersion (AEP-REQ-161).

Commitment.description: Digest over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical bytes of the commitment preimage { experimentId, experimentVersion, assignments: { <label>: <configuration reference> }, salt } (AEP-REQ-160). The salt makes the digest useless for guessing the mapping from a list of candidate models; disclosing the preimage later, outside AEP, lets anyone verify the mapping was not changed after results were seen.

VariantBinding.description: Snapshot of the blinded variant a session ran against, resolved at the created→active transition and fixed for the session (AEP-REQ-157). Identical on the session record, the Trace, the EvaluationResult and the session.started stream event. Carries the label, never the configuration behind it.

commitment.description: The commitment in force when the session bound, copied from the Agent Contract. Lets an auditor holding the disclosed preimage tie this exact session to the configuration it ran.
